Off by default. When enabled, HookLab sends rate-limited event codes for MCC, Neo Store and Droid-ify to LSPosed logs via libxposed. No account details, app-page data, repository URLs, credentials or exception messages. Restart the target apps after changing this setting to reliably refresh framework preferences.

Hooked processes cannot write libxposed remote preferences. Runtime outcomes are reported as sanitized events in LSPosed logs, not stored here. An installer failure prevents another attempt in the same host process, but cannot automatically lock future processes. The module app can set persistent manual safety locks. No app content or exception messages are logged. Restart the host app after changing a lock.

Show Run in Termux in Android Share
Could not change Android share-target setting.
Share commands from other apps, or paste from the clipboard; no LSPosed hooks needed.
Review and edit the command before executing it in a new foreground Termux Zsh session.

Setup: install Zsh in Termux. Enable allow-external-apps=true in ~/.termux/termux.properties and grant HookLab the Run commands in Termux environment permission. These settings are never changed automatically.
Waiting for a shared command or a clipboard paste. Nothing runs automatically.
Command loaded for review. Nothing has executed.
Could not read the shared text; no command was executed.
Execute the exact reviewed command in a new foreground Termux Zsh session? This may change files and accounts. No root or background execution is added by HookLab.
Termux (com.termux) is not installed or visible.
Grant HookLab the Run commands in Termux environment permission in Android App settings. After granting, review and tap Run again.
Permission granted; review and tap Run again. Nothing executed.
Could not dispatch to Termux. Check permissions, Termux installation and allow-external-apps=true.
Dispatch requested. Check the Termux terminal; completion and exit status are not yet verified.
